objective: Compare the value delivered to the user: real German companies, valid submitted-lane business, Cudy-relevant active networking, and a usable cooperation path.
submissionBoundary: Provider output proposes candidates and may include helpful citations, but provider-authored summaries and missing provider citations never decide candidate truth or main-score eligibility.

independentAdjudication.zeroScoreRule: Only a verified-fail decision or a failed independently supported value gate may force zero. Retrieval failure alone remains unresolved.
independentAdjudication.finalizationRule: Every specially adjudicated Gemini Full candidate must be resolved before the leaderboard is final.

independentInformationConfidenceLevels.5: Current, specific official material resolves the company, Germany, active-networking, lane and operational path claims.
independentInformationConfidenceLevels.4: Concrete official material resolves the core claims, but one operational detail is indirect, group-level or less specific.
independentInformationConfidenceLevels.3: Official material supports the core classification but remains broad about products or operational control.
independentInformationConfidenceLevels.2: Only partial independently checkable support exists.
independentInformationConfidenceLevels.1: The claim remains weak after independent review.
independentInformationConfidenceLevels.0: No independently usable information was found or the claim is contradicted.

mainScore.interpretation: Product/use-case fit and cooperation path contribute 80% of the score. Independent information confidence contributes 20%.

providerEvidenceCompleteness.definition: Share of submitted canonical occurrences for which the discovery provider supplied at least one non-empty URL and excerpt in its own submission.
providerEvidenceCompleteness.warning: This measures submission structure, not whether a provider claim is correct or independently verifiable.

humanAudit.reason: The confirmed role, lane, fit and cooperation-path rubric is unchanged; v1.4 corrects the evidence-source boundary and reuses the completed v1.3 human calibration.
